page.layout: One scan showing the outside of a closed book: a blind-tooled leather binding in a decorative panel design with a central panel and a worn title strip at the top. No printed page text is present; the only printing is the faint tooled ornament of the cover.
page.notes: The scan shows the front board of a bound volume (pigskin or calf over boards, with brass clasps and straps at the left edge). The top strip carries faint gilt or blind-tooled lettering that is too worn to read, so no words can be transcribed. The central panel holds an ornamental roll-tool design, not text. Nothing on this image is a printed page of the book, so no main text, running head or page number is given.
